levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد
عبد الله بن محمد بن عيسى

notes: The chain is read as written: Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Hasan ibn Mahbub and Uthman ibn Isa (after the «؛»), both from Husayn ibn Nu'aym; the bracketed «[ال]» is left out of the surface.

Husayn speaks in the first person and then relays a scene: Ali ibn Yaqtin tells of Musa ibn Ja'far, who speaks and acts in it, and Hisham ibn al-Hakam answers. An Imam who speaks and acts in a narrated encounter is rule 11, so the Imam is not written as a link here.
The leading «3 - نص آخر» and the blessings are not part of the surfaces.
